column2: [intro]
Success calls me, beckons me,
But what lies behind it all?
Will my faithful friends still be there,
Once the spotlights stop shining.
Glory calls me, I can't resist,
But will I be the same once I'm elevated?
Abandon my loved ones, leave everything,
Beyond the lights, who will I be?
My beloved family, my solid pillar,
Should I abandon them for this new guide?
But the price of success, is it so clear?,
Beyond the lights, at what cost do I decide?

But will I be the same once I'm elevated?
Abandon my loved ones, leave everything,
Beyond the lights, who will I be?
